content.text:
**9,675 days.** Wolfram|Alpha returns "9675 days" for the span from Monday, February 12, 2024 to Tuesday, August 9, 2050. It also gives the span as 26 years 5 months 28 days, or 1382 weeks 1 day.

I also checked this by hand: 26 years from Feb 12, 2024 to Feb 12, 2050 contains 7 leap days (2024, 2028, 2032, 2036, 2040, 2044, 2048), giving 9,497 days. Feb 12 to Aug 9, 2050 adds 178 days, for 9,675 total.
